findings.title: Sprite re-added after gesture teardown
findings.message: The sprite paint closure assigns to the captured variable y (a local copy), which is harmless, but the closure is created per publish and the previous sprite with the same name is replaced on every animation frame. Each frame allocates a new sprite and closure. More importantly, the animation Func runs on the render path and can call publishLine after stopAnimation or after the stage is deleted, re-adding a sprite that is never cleaned up.
findings.suggestion: In the animation Func and publishLine, check that the gesture is still active (for example g.scope.input.allowed() and g.hasLine) before re-adding the sprite, and clear hasLine in end() so a late frame cannot recreate it.
